name: Metasploitable2: DistCC RCE
short_description: Exploit the DistCC daemon for remote code execution on Metasploitable2.
description: Metasploitable2 is a deliberately vulnerable Linux VM created by Rapid7 for security training. The DistCC (Distributed C Compiler) daemon allows remote code execution due to a misconfiguration. This is CVE-2004-2687.

steps.title: Scan the target for open ports
steps.explanation: Full port scan to discover all services. Metasploitable2 has many vulnerable services. We're looking for port 3632 (DistCC).

steps.title: Start Metasploit
steps.explanation: Launch Metasploit Framework in quiet mode.

steps.title: Search for DistCC exploits
steps.explanation: Find exploits for the DistCC service.

steps.title: Load the DistCC exploit
steps.explanation: Select the DistCC remote code execution module.

steps.title: View options
steps.explanation: Check required parameters. RHOSTS (target) and LHOST (your IP for reverse shell) are needed.

steps.title: Set your attack machine IP
steps.explanation: This is the Kali container's IP for the reverse shell connection.

steps.title: Set the payload
steps.explanation: Use a bash reverse shell payload.

steps.title: Run the exploit
steps.explanation: Execute the exploit and get a shell.

steps.title: Check your access
steps.explanation: See what user you're running as.

steps.title: Escalate to root (optional)
steps.explanation: Get a proper interactive shell. From here you can explore privilege escalation.

success_criteria: You have a command shell on Metasploitable2. Run 'id' and 'hostname' to confirm you're on the target system.
next_steps: Try other Metasploitable2 services: vsftpd, Samba, IRC
Use 'background' to keep the session and attack other services
